build_FP16Optimizer: build an FP16 optimizer with FP32 master params for mixed precision training
build_MemoryEfficientFP16Optimizer: build a memory efficient FP16 optimizer that skips maintaining FP32 model copies
build_fp32_params: build FP32 copies of model parameters with optional flattening for gradient storage
backward_FP16Optimizer: run backward pass with dynamic loss scaling to prevent gradient underflow in FP16
clip_grad_norm_FP16Optimizer: clip gradient norm and update the dynamic loss scaler during FP16 training
